mission: Prepare University of Tampa students for careers in healthcare through rigorous scholarship, structured mentorship, clinical exposure, and sustained community service in the Tampa Bay area.
history: Mu Epsilon Delta was founded in 1965 at the University of Tennessee at Martin as a co-educational professional fraternity for students pursuing pre-health careers. The University of Tampa chapter carries that mission onto Plant Hall’s campus—connecting pre-med, pre-PA, dental, pharmacy, nursing, and research-bound Spartans.
foundingStory: National colors are maroon and gold; the symbol is the caduceus; the flower is the red rambling rose; the jewel is the ruby. Our motto: “With purity and passion I pass my life and practice my art.” At UT, we live that vow through scholarship cohorts, Tampa Bay service partnerships, and a brotherhood that shows up for one another.

president.name: Alex Rivera
president.quote: Since joining MED at UT, this chapter has been the most consistent source of support on my pre-health path. Upperclass mentors, alumni advice, and a brotherhood that feels like home have made Tampa feel smaller—and the journey clearer. Whatever stage you’re at, I hope you find the same belonging and mentorship here. Reach out anytime.
